messages:
Rae (Partnerships): Orion Systems PO rejected by portal. Vendor uploaded signed PO for 'Orion Systems Ltd' but our vendor record is 'Orion Systems, Inc'. Procurement returned: vendor_name_mismatch. We have a partner webinar Tue. Can we short-circuit? @Gus?
Gus (Procurement): Portal enforces exact legal name. We need a corrected PO or vendor attestation on letterhead linking the names. Temporary enable possible but only with Legal and Finance waivers.
marketplace-bot: ingestion -> REJECTED {"ticket":"MP-31333","reason":"vendor_name_mismatch"}
Orion CSM: Vendor says US finance used their UK template by mistake. They can reissue corrected PO tomorrow but ask for a 48h provisional enable for the webinar.
Helen (Legal): We can accept a signed attestation that states both names refer to the same legal entity and that signatory has authority. I'll draft a 1-paragraph attestation and require DocuSign. If signed, Legal will approve provisional acceptance for 72 hours.
Marta (Finance): If Legal approves provisional, I can create a provisional ledger code PROV-ORION-01 and set payments on hold until final docs. No payout until EIN/name match.
Liam (Sales): Webinar depends on this. If attestation isn't signed by EOD tomorrow Sales will need to postpone. Can Partnerships push the vendor AE?
Rae (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Helen to post attestation template to MP-31333, 2) Orion CSM to get DocuSign signed attestation ASAP, 3) Marta will create provisional ledger on attach, 4) Gus to mark portal PROVISIONAL_ENABLED on attach. I'll escalate to channel lead if we miss EOD. Thanks.
